Subject: Draft MAP & next steps — POC network / SSO readiness (GridLytics)

Hi Alex / Priya — thanks again for the call today. Quick recap and a first-pass Mutual Action Plan focused on the POC environment dependencies so we can keep to your target evaluation window. I attached a one-page MAP (MAP-draft-v2.xlsx) with milestones; below are the technical items we discussed and proposed ownership.

Summary of POC goals (from today's call):
- Run a 2-week workload against a 4x A100-equivalent pool, validate end-to-end latency and cost per 1k tokens.
- Verify SSO integration and audit/event logging into your SIEM.
- Confirm data handling via KMS-backed secrets and no persistent customer data retained outside intermediate caches.

POC milestone (network & identity) — proposed owners and target dates:
1) VPC peering & route validation — Owner: GridLytics infra (Priya) — Target: 2026-08-10
2) IP allowlist (ingress to Redwood peering endpoints) — Owner: GridLytics infra — Target: 2026-08-10
3) SSO/SAML integration (IdP config + test user) — Owner: GridLytics app team (Alex) / Redwood (Marissa) — Target: 2026-08-12
4) KMS & secrets config (key policy + short-lived credentials) — Owner: GridLytics SecOps / Redwood infra — Target: 2026-08-11
5) Smoke tests (connectivity, authentication, sample inference) — Owner: Redwood SE (Marissa) & GridLytics infra — Target: 2026-08-13

Dependencies / open items we need confirmation on from your side:
- Preferred VPC CIDR(s) for peering and whether NAT is used for outbound (we need routable ranges).
- IP ranges to add to our allowlist (we will provide the endpoints once peering is accepted).
- SAML metadata URL (IdP metadata) or a SAML metadata file + contact for SSO testing.
- KMS key ARN(s) and whether GridLytics will push a cross-account policy or we should create a customer-managed key on our side.

Next steps: please confirm owners and the dates above or propose alternatives. If you prefer, I can convert the items above into Jira tasks and share a link.

Attaching: MAP-draft-v2.xlsx (one-page milestones, responsibilities, target dates).

Thanks — looking forward to getting this scheduled so we hit the evaluation window.

Thanks, Sergio — appreciate the clear breakdown. Quick confirmations from our side and a couple of clarifying questions.

Confirmations:
- We can own VPC peering and IP allowlist. I'll have Priya (infra) lead routing work; she is copied.
- SSO: we'll provide SAML metadata URL by EOD Wednesday (2026-08-04). Our IdP team will create a test user and a dedicated OIDC/SAML test client for the POC.
- KMS: we prefer to provide a customer-managed key in our account and add Redwood as a principal via key policy. We'll send ARNs and an initial policy snippet.

Clarifying items:
- For peering, do you require a public endpoint or is private peering to a VPC endpoint sufficient?
- For IP allowlist, do you need both control-plane and data-plane ranges? We can provide a single combined set if that simplifies routing.

I'll assign Priya to coordinate the routing info and to share our network contact (infra@gridlytics.com). We'll aim to meet the targets you proposed; if anything delays we'll flag as soon as possible.

Subject: Re: Draft MAP & next steps — POC network / SSO readiness (GridLytics)

Thanks Alex / Priya — helpful. A few technical notes from the SE side to make the MAP actionable. I'll be the Redwood lead on the SSO test and the smoke tests.

Technical checklist & what we need from GridLytics to complete each step:
1) VPC peering & routing
   - Need: peering request JSON with VPC IDs, and confirmation whether peering is transitive in your environment (it impacts route table updates).
   - Notes: We provision a peering connection from our side to your POC VPC; private peering is fine. If NAT is in the path, make sure outbound to our control endpoints is allowed.
2) IP allowlist (ingress)
   - Need: final list of source IP ranges (or confirmation you want to accept our peering endpoint ranges).
   - Our endpoints: we'll provide egress IP block 44.210.34.0/24 and control plane 44.210.35.0/25 once peering is established.
3) SAML / SSO
   - Need: SAML metadata URL or XML, NameID format preference, and at least one test account with SAML group mapping.
   - We will provide an SP metadata file and a short test plan (create user → login → assert group mapping).
4) KMS & secrets
   - Need: KMS ARN(s) and the principal you'd like to grant (we can accept a role/service principal).
   - For short-lived creds we prefer to use an automated workflow (we'll generate ephemeral tokens) — we just need permission to decrypt the secrets used for the POC.
5) Smoke tests
   - We'll schedule a 2-hour block for connectivity and a sample inference run. Please confirm a Slack channel or a technical bridge for real-time troubleshooting.

Proposed adjusted dates (to account for SAML metadata delivery):
- VPC peering & IP allowlist: 2026-08-10 (as proposed)
- SSO metadata & test user: 2026-08-05 (deliverable) / test by 2026-08-12
- KMS ARNs: 2026-08-06
- Smoke tests: 2026-08-13

If those look good I'll update the MAP spreadsheet and convert items into PR tasks for our side (link to follow).

Attached: network-diagram-v1.png (from GridLytics).

- Marissa
